title: GetItemName
description: GetItemName is a lightweight, developer-friendly plugin that instantly displays detailed information about the item you're holding. Whether you're customizing items or just curious, GetItemName simplifies everything into one command.
body:
**GetItemName** is a lightweight, developer-friendly plugin that gives you instant, detailed information about the item you're currently holding. Whether you're debugging custom gear, designing items, or just exploring Minecraft mechanics, this plugin makes it all effortless — in just one command.

---

**🔧 Core Features:**  
- 🏷 **Item Name Display:** Shows the item's name directly in chat  
- 🎨 **Color Code Detection:** Detects and displays any **hex color codes** or RGB values  
- ✨ **Enchantments List:** Lists all enchantments applied to the item  
- 💔 **Durability Info:** Shows **current durability**, **maximum durability**, and percentage left  
- 🖱 **Clickable Output:** Click the item name in chat to copy or reference it (plugin/client dependent)  
- 🌍 **Multilingual Support:** Built-in support for **English**, **Italian**, and **Spanish**  
- ⚙️ **Highly Configurable:**  
  - Enable/disable specific features (durability, color codes, etc.)  
  - Customize all messages in your desired language file
  - Adjust output formats to match your style  

---

![How it looks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef8c3410e1564394dda3ec9ba6c248e54ba3c5a8.png)

---

**🛠 Admin & Utility Commands:**  
- `/getitemname` – Get full item info (name, enchantments, color, durability)  
- `/getitemname help` – Displays help and usage guide  
- `/getitemname reload` – Reload config and language files on-the-fly  
- `/getitemname debug` – Output full item data to console for developers  

---

**📁 File Structure:**  
- `config.yml` – Toggle features, set formatting, and output styles  
- `languages/` – Separate files for English, Italian, and Spanish  

---
